description: This source file defines a PHP class 'Captcha' within the OpenCart e-commerce system. The class provides controller functionality for managing CAPTCHA extensions in the admin interface, including listing available CAPTCHAs, installing, and uninstalling extensions. It interacts with the filesystem, models, language components, and URLs within the OpenCart framework.

classes.name: Captcha
classes.description: Controller class for managing CAPTCHA extensions in the admin panel of OpenCart. Handles listing installed and available CAPTCHA modules, installing new modules, and uninstalling existing ones.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point; outputs the list of CAPTCHA extensions.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves, prepares, and displays list of CAPTCHA extensions, their statuses, and actions.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles the installation process of a CAPTCHA extension, including permission checks, filesystem verification, and registration within the system.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Handles the uninstallation process of a CAPTCHA extension, including permission checks and cleanup.
